text:
anita g: quick question from the PM sync: can leadership confirm release sequencing and primary owners for API, Console, and Optimize? some teams need to freeze deps by Friday.
jess carter: short answer: API -> Console -> Optimize. Owners: API = eng-runtime (lead: jess carter), Console = eng-platform (partner PM: anita g), Optimize = eng-ml (contact: rafael). full notes below.
omar (infra): do we have hard freeze cutoffs for infra changes (eg. kernel upgrades, AMI rotations) tied to each release window? need dates to coordinate capacity.
jess carter: tentative code freeze windows: API: 2026-08-01 -> 2026-08-15 (GA target), Console beta: 2026-09-15 -> 2026-09-30, Optimize v1: 2026-11-01 -> 2026-11-15. will firm up on the one-pager.
kevin (sales): customer pilots? are there specific PD/enterprise customers lined up for Console beta and Optimize trials? we need names to prep contracts.
jess carter: Console beta: two pilots (AcmeHealth, Gridware). Optimize trials: invite list of enterprise customers on Dedicated; will share opt-in form.
anita g: request: can we also call out monitoring and acceptance metrics per release? PMs want to know exactly what passes.
jess carter: yes. API GA metrics: 99.9% p99 latency < 300ms on production-like load, error rate < 0.1% sustained. Console beta acceptance: RBAC audit logs present, successful RBAC tests with pilot customers, no high-severity security findings. Optimize v1: end-to-end cost report showing >=15% estimated unit cost savings on sample workload + no accuracy regression >2% on eval sets.
omar (infra): for rollback plan, how many model variants need to be packaged for automatic fallback? we can't add more in the last minute.
jess carter: plan: two fallback families per model family (quantized and standard). fallback routing controlled by feature flag per tenant. default: enterprise = enabled, self-serve = disabled.
kevin (sales): sticky ask from legal: EU data residency and migration assistance terms for Dedicated customers during Console beta. any changes?
jess carter: no change to residency terms; migration assistance window will expand to 24/7 concierge for pilot customers for first 30 days. details in the one-pager and SOW template.
anita g: can release-bot create a tracking issue and add owners + dates so teams can link their sprints?
release-bot: Created task RW-REL-5301 "Roadmap release plan: API/Console/Optimize - owners & gates" assigned to jess carter, anita g, omar (infra), due 2026-07-09.
anita g: perfect. one more: can product publish a tiny FAQ for teams with known blockers and who to ping? we had lots of side-threads during the sync.
jess carter: yes. i'll publish FAQ + owners matrix today and drop it into #all-hands plus the roadmap doc. tagging @release-bot to attach links once live. :white_check_mark:
